1.7.8.en: Renamed the app to "EcoFlow - Stream Systems" to better reflect its focus on the STREAM range.

1.7.7.en: New app icon using the EcoFlow EF monogram, replacing the previous sun-and-battery icon.

1.7.6.en: Updated the App Store image to a real-life photo of the STREAM battery and balcony solar panels at home.

1.7.5.en: New App Store image showing the STREAM battery and solar panels on a white background.

1.7.4.en: Real product photos for STREAM Battery, STREAM Unit, STREAM Solar and Smart Plug device images (on a white background).

1.7.3.en: STREAM Unit icon redrawn as a clean outline so it no longer appears as a solid black shape on the device tile.

1.7.2.en: New device-specific icons for STREAM Battery, STREAM Solar and Smart Plug. Removed the PowerStream device, which is not offered by this app.

1.7.1.en: Fix: existing STREAM Ultra X units now correctly gain their solar PV input tiles (previously only brand-new pairings showed them).

1.7.0.en: STREAM Unit devices are now fully controllable, tailored to each model and its role. Every unit gains AC output 1/2 switches and AC output power; the system main unit also gains the whole-home controls and flow tiles (operating mode, backup reserve, charge/discharge limits, grid feed-in, house consumption and the house power split). Solar models (e.g. STREAM Ultra X) show their PV inputs; AC-coupled models (e.g. STREAM AC Pro) hide the solar tiles they cannot report.

1.6.9.en: New STREAM Unit icon: the device icon and images now show the STREAM unit itself (3D enclosure with its front display panel and side cooling fins) instead of a generic battery, so the 6 physical STREAM units are easier to recognise at a glance.

1.6.8.en: STREAM Unit devices are now tailored to their exact model. Each unit's Settings page shows its model, serial number, role in the system and energy source, and AC-coupled units (e.g. STREAM AC Pro) no longer show solar (PV) tiles they cannot report. STREAM Battery, Solar and Microinverter devices are unchanged.

1.6.0.en: Polished for the Homey App Store: refreshed app and device icons (full-canvas, each device now has its own unique icon), new lively app artwork and clean white-background device images, plus a tidier app name and description. No changes to how your devices work.

1.5.0.en: Per-unit detail like the EcoFlow app: each STREAM Unit now shows its own solar (PV1–4) and time-to-full/empty. The STREAM Microinverter is now supported as a solar device (PV1/PV2 + generated energy + grid feed).

1.4.0.en: Internal hardening: a shared device foundation reduces duplicated code, the realtime (MQTT) connection now recovers from certificate expiry with backoff and survives credential changes without losing updates, and the energy widget now shows today's solar. No changes to how your devices work.

1.3.1.en: Reliability fixes from a multi-model code review: prevents duplicate MQTT sessions, stops energy meters double-counting under concurrent updates, keeps cumulative meters monotonic when switching the meter mode, fixes the 'charging started' flow trigger after idle, avoids offline/online flapping, and cleans up the MQTT connection on app shutdown.

1.3.0.en: New 'STREAM Energy Flow' dashboard widget showing the live EcoFlow-style picture — Grid, Solar, Home and Battery (with % and charge state) in kW, refreshing every few seconds.

1.2.0.en: New EcoFlow-style icons and graphics throughout, including a clearer electricity-meter icon. Each AC socket on STREAM AC Pro / Ultra X is now its own smart-plug device (on/off + live power). The Smart Meter can show either Grid power or total Home load (device settings), adds live Grid import / Grid export tiles, and updates faster.

1.1.0.en: Full Homey Energy integration: STREAM is now a proper home battery (charged/discharged meters), with a new STREAM Solar device and the Smart Meter as a grid meter. Fixes discovery of all STREAM models (Ultra X, AC Pro, etc.). Configure your EcoFlow keys once — pairing more devices no longer re-asks. Adds settable charge/discharge limits, fault alarms, and richer realtime data over MQTT.

1.0.0.en: Initial release: EcoFlow STREAM monitoring & control (battery, solar, grid, AC outputs, backup reserve, operating mode, feed-in), Smart Meter (per-phase power/voltage/current + energy), Homey Energy integration, Flow cards and Insights, with realtime MQTT updates.

1.6.1.en: Polished for the Homey App Store: refreshed full-canvas app and device icons (each device now unique), lively new app artwork, clean white-background device images, and a tidier name and description. No changes to device behaviour.

1.6.2.en: Improves the STREAM and STREAM Unit device views with clearer energy-flow labels, better capability ordering, and per-unit battery-flow status.

1.6.3.en: Clarifies the STREAM Solar device as a whole-system solar aggregate and removes misleading per-unit PV input tiles from that aggregate view.

1.6.4.en: Adds STREAM Solar settings that explain the aggregate source and list each STREAM unit's PV inputs contributing to the system solar total.

1.6.5.en: Refreshes the EcoFlow driver icons and device images so each STREAM-related device is easier to recognise in Homey.

1.6.6.en: Updates the STREAM Microinverter and Smart Meter driver images to match the real EcoFlow devices more closely.

1.6.7.en: Updates the STREAM battery driver icons and images so the battery devices are easier to recognise in Homey.

1.7.9.en: App icon now shows the white EcoFlow monogram on a black background.

1.7.10.en: Renamed the app to "EcoFlow STREAM Series".

1.8.0.en: Accurate per-model solar inputs, smarter energy tiles, new Octopus-style tariff Flow actions (cheap-charge / peak-export), a battery-level condition, and AC-output info.

1.8.1.en: Improve Homey device tile icons for STREAM capability status and controls.

1.8.2.en: Add STREAM dashboard widgets and improve Smart Meter and Microinverter live icons/status indicators.

1.8.3.en: Harden API security, realtime reliability, energy accounting, Flows, widgets, and CI.

1.8.4.en: Improve STREAM device icons, model identification, and Home Battery pairing.

1.8.5.en: Add support for optional PayPal donations through Homey's native Donate button.

1.8.6.en: Extend the backup reserve control to 100% and improve App Store search tags.

1.9.0.en: Five dashboard widgets each now have their own accurate preview. Safer backup-reserve control fixes a case where changes could silently fail. Energy meters stay accurate across restarts and a sturdier realtime connection. New tariff/grid Flow cards. STREAM Max solar-input correction.

1.10.0.en: German and Dutch translations. New: a real solar forecast (today and tomorrow) from your local weather, plus tariff-aware Flows that work with any electricity-price app (Octopus, Tibber, aWATTar and more). Sturdier connectivity and more reliable widgets.

1.10.1.en: Better App Store discoverability with more search tags, now also in German and Dutch.

1.10.2.en: Adds the Homey Community support link and German and Dutch App Store descriptions.

1.10.3.en: Rebuilt all five widget preview pairs as text-free, transparent artwork that follows the Homey Widget Preview guidelines.

1.10.4.en: Adds experimental monitoring-only STREAM AC 5000 support. Improves STREAM Home Battery widgets with aggregate-only selection, configurable capacity, stored/usable kWh, and more accurate runtime estimates. Includes reliability and security updates.

1.10.5.en: Updated the STREAM AC 5000 driver icon and app store images.

1.10.6.en: Prevents unsupported STREAM devices from polling or accepting controls through the Developer API, improves dedicated-driver guidance, and clarifies the monitoring-only STREAM AC 5000 connection.

1.10.7.en: Improved STREAM AC 5000 battery percentage, Homey Energy integration, telemetry resilience, and diagnostics.

1.10.8.en: Add a durable STREAM 5000 Series Unit driver with verified STREAM AC 5000 support, preserving existing devices through the legacy compatibility driver.

1.10.9.en: Adds Homey-recommended cumulative charged and discharged energy tracking for STREAM 5000 Series and AC 5000 devices, with persistent totals, restart safety, and stale-data protection.

1.10.10.en: Added a dedicated STREAM Home Battery for 5000-series installations, kept physical 5000 units as separate monitors to prevent duplicate Homey Energy accounting, expanded Energy Flow and Battery Plan widget support, and improved pairing and migration guidance.

1.10.11.en: Corrected the Homey Store descriptions for the new STREAM 5000 installation Home Battery and optional physical-monitor roles.

1.10.12.en: Added opt-in STREAM 5000 beta pairing with unsupported-API warnings, Beta-labelled devices, cumulative charged/discharged unit meters, and guidance to prevent duplicate Homey Energy totals.

1.10.13.en: Added standalone STREAM Unit Homey Energy support with individual live power, charged/discharged meters, and safe aggregate widget filtering.

1.10.14.en: Simplified STREAM energy reporting so physical units are telemetry-only and all Homey Energy power and charged/discharged totals come from STREAM Home Battery.

1.10.15.en: Simplified STREAM energy reporting so physical units are telemetry-only and all Homey Energy power and charged/discharged totals come from STREAM Home Battery.

1.10.16.en: Updated STREAM 5000 driver icons to use the accurate AC 5000 wireframe artwork across the physical unit and Home Battery roles.

1.10.17.en: Simplified the supported-device names to STREAM Home Battery and STREAM Unit while preserving clear pairing guidance for aggregate and individual devices.

1.10.18.en: Improves STREAM 5000 system and unit telemetry, strengthens battery energy checkpointing and stale-update handling, and adds privacy-safe setup and Energy diagnostics. Existing pairing is preserved; STREAM 5000 remains read-only.

1.10.19.en: Add opt-in STREAM 5000 ES21 core monitoring, anonymous expansion and installation discovery diagnostics, improved lifecycle safety and guarded original STREAM Flow readback. Preserve installation-only Homey Energy; expansion, Gateway, STREAM 3000 pairing and 5000 controls remain disabled pending validation.

1.10.20.en: Correct STREAM 5000 battery-to-backup-socket discharge accounting. Add read-only, session-only configuration diagnostics for power limits, mode, reserve, SOC limits and schedules, with receipt-age labels. Preserve existing pairing, saved counters and installation-only Homey Energy. ES21/ES22 remain monitoring-only beta; hardware validation is still required.

1.10.21.en: Correct STREAM 5000 battery-to-backup-socket discharge accounting. Add read-only, session-only configuration diagnostics with receipt-age labels. Align ES21/ES22 Test pairing guidance. Preserve saved counters and installation-only Homey Energy; no re-pairing required. Hardware validation remains required.

1.10.22.en: Improve STREAM 5000 reading freshness, read-only settings and physical solar/socket monitoring. Correct original STREAM aggregate/unit battery readings and socket support; harden control readback, connection handling and daily history. Existing pairing and cumulative counters are preserved. STREAM 5000 controls remain disabled.

1.10.23.en: Improve support reports with anonymous cached battery and power readings, plus original STREAM reporting-source and receipt-age diagnostics. No pairing, Energy accounting or battery control changes.

1.10.24.en: Add a Copy report button and clearer support-report sharing instructions. Improve safe control failure diagnostics without changing battery grouping, Energy accounting or control safeguards.

1.10.25.en: Add read-only original STREAM PV3/4 voltage and current diagnostics with model-specific port limits, independent freshness and stale-value clearing. Improve support reporting and regression coverage. Energy accounting is unchanged; physical PV port ordering remains provisional.

1.10.26.en: Refresh STREAM 5000 icons and store artwork from the AC 5000 product photo. Rename the devices to STREAM 5000 Series Unit and STREAM Home Battery (5000), without the Beta suffix. Existing pairings, monitoring-only safeguards and Homey Energy accounting are unchanged.

1.10.27.en: Improve original Smart Meter telemetry with direct MQTT readings and linked-installation fallback, fresh per-phase measurements, and clear meter-source diagnostics. Add read-only battery reporter and counter evidence checks. Energy accounting, existing pairings and control safeguards remain unchanged; Dual CT support is not enabled.

1.10.28.en: Correct the STREAM 5000 Series Unit and STREAM Home Battery (5000) store pictures to use the supplied AC 5000 product photo on white. Keep the existing wireframe device icons. No pairing, Energy accounting or control changes.

1.10.29.en: Add read-only mixed-generation reporter comparisons with exact identity correlation, per-field freshness, UTC support report timestamps and safer lookup lifecycle handling. Homey Energy accounting and controls remain unchanged.

1.10.30.en: Adds an optional linked 5000 monitoring reporter trial with fresh-source checks, rollback safeguards, clearer reading scope, readiness guidance and downloadable integration reports. Default-off; controls remain blocked during the trial and original energy accounting/history are unchanged.

1.10.31.en: Improved mixed-generation diagnostics with anonymous per-battery readings and independent freshness checks. Clarified reported grid-meter versus flow-derived grid power, and added regression tests. Battery controls and energy accounting remain unchanged.

1.10.32.en: Improved support-report timeouts and snapshot-age labels, added clock-recovery safeguards and bounded monitoring reliability summaries, and expanded outage/restart regression tests. Battery controls and energy accounting remain unchanged.

1.10.33.en: Improved linked STREAM monitoring during reading updates, tightened power freshness, added individual-unit diagnostic observations and clearer support guidance. Battery controls and energy accounting remain unchanged.

1.10.34.en: Improve original STREAM reading freshness, correct Home Battery grid and remaining-time scopes, clarify Unit/System labels, and add matched support capture guidance with anonymous peer/counter and read-only limit diagnostics. Energy accounting and control safeguards remain unchanged.

1.10.35.en: Align the original STREAM grid tile with EcoFlow: Unit grid connection port. Existing default labels migrate while custom names and Flow references are preserved. Readings, signs, energy accounting and controls are unchanged.

1.10.36.en: Fix original STREAM Unit startup failing with Invalid Capability: stream_unit_power_grid when capability options are unavailable. Cosmetic title migration can no longer block device startup. Existing devices, Flows, readings and energy accounting are preserved; no re-pairing is required.

1.10.37.en: Improves integration report downloads with a complete numbered-parts fallback, restores original STREAM unit battery flow from fresh BMS telemetry when available, and shows remaining-time estimates only for matching fresh battery direction. Energy accounting and device pairing remain unchanged.

1.10.38.en: Adds scoped BMS, peer and grid reading comparisons with short session-only histories, bounds queued original STREAM telemetry during slow Homey writes, and protects pasted integration report parts against forum formatting. Energy accounting, device pairing and hardware controls remain unchanged.

1.10.39.en: Add opt-in read-only Dual CT discovery across saved app and Developer accounts, clearer local capture summaries and anonymous observation history. Harden slow-connection cancellation and shared subscription cleanup. Remove the one-minute support capture deadline. Dual CT pairing, channel readings, Energy and controls remain disabled pending verification.

1.10.40.en: Add compact Dual CT reports with bounded model-code evidence, safe telemetry structure, copy/download feedback and read-only preview guidance. Dual CT readings, pairing, Energy, Flows and controls remain disabled pending verification.

1.10.41.en: Allow field-observed app productType 421 in opt-in read-only Dual CT discovery. Show provisional identity and clearer connection/capture outcomes, preserving selected-meter evidence in compact reports. Dual CT pairing, readings, Energy, Flows and controls remain disabled.

1.10.42.en: Retain representative Dual CT JSON and protobuf structure in compact reports instead of discarding all structure at the size limit. Merge duplicates, show partial coverage and record received-source provenance. Diagnostic only; Dual CT pairing, readings, Energy, Flows and controls remain disabled.

1.10.43.en: Add optional read-only Dual CT numeric candidate preview with explicit consent, per-field expiry and clearer unavailable reasons. Provide a separate reviewed candidate JSON export; normal support reports remain structure-only. Units, channel roles and direction remain unverified; no Dual CT pairing, Energy, Flows or controls.

1.10.44.en: Fix Dual CT receipt confirmation and add compact encoding/preview diagnostics. Show effective capture mode, keep consent explicit and refresh the local summary and preview together. Numeric candidates remain separate, unverified and excluded from normal reports; no Dual CT Energy, Flows or controls.

1.10.45.en: Improve optional read-only Dual CT candidate decoding for omitted encoding markers, add field provenance and unitless additional candidates, and clarify compact report coverage. Energy accounting and controls are unchanged.

1.10.46.en: Fix read-only Dual CT export expiry: retain a separately consented historical snapshot for up to 15 minutes while live preview fields still expire individually at 90 seconds. Add explicit historical labels, bounded export coverage and privacy cleanup. Energy accounting and controls are unchanged.

1.10.47.en: Add read-only Dual CT candidate bank labels, per-payload provenance and signed same-payload power-sum diagnostics. Keep bank roles, units and direction unverified; no Energy accounting or controls changes.

1.10.48.en: Read-only Dual CT comparison cards, optional unscaled counter candidates and receipt-based continuity diagnostics. Improved compact and combined exports and capture cleanup. No changes to pairing, Homey Energy, Flows or device controls.

1.10.49.en: Improved read-only Dual CT preview with provisional Grid and Solar/inverter labels and candidate energy values. Fixed counter freshness between sparse updates and preserved more evidence in compact comparison exports. No changes to pairing, Homey Energy, Flows or device controls.

1.10.50.en: Made read-only Dual CT export availability clearer, with specific reasons for disabled options and matching combined-report availability. Improved freshness consistency and duplicate-packet handling, with additional replay and upgrade regression checks. No changes to pairing, Homey Energy, Flows or device controls.

1.10.51.en: Made read-only Dual CT export availability clearer, with specific reasons for disabled options and matching combined-report availability, including expired snapshots after a later refresh. Improved freshness consistency and duplicate-packet handling, with additional replay and upgrade regression checks. No changes to pairing, Homey Energy, Flows or device controls.

1.10.52.en: Added an optional read-only Dual CT preview device with separate raw bank readings and freshness status. Simplified capture and combined JSON export. Prepared and tested a power-based Energy path; Dual CT Energy adoption and controls remain disabled pending validation.

1.10.53.en: Clarified the read-only Dual CT preview with CT1/CT2 labels, localized V/A/W values and readable precision. Raw counters now warn that units, period and circuit are unconfirmed, with individual receipt ages. Existing device identities are preserved; Dual CT Energy and controls remain disabled.

1.10.54.en: Dual CT preview: separate per-phase power, voltage and current readings, guarded circuit phase sums, and optional circuit descriptions. Existing previews upgrade without re-pairing. Includes disabled grid Energy preparation; no Dual CT Energy activation or controls.

1.10.55.en: Add opt-in read-only battery coordination previews and observation Flow cards. Clarify circuit scopes and existing battery-limit wording. Reject stale or missing STREAM and dated solar-forecast readings while preserving existing Flow identities. No new charging controls or Dual CT Energy activation.

1.10.56.en: Fix recovery after timed-out coordination reads, clarify source freshness and permission lifetimes, and strengthen lifecycle and release checks. Existing Flows are preserved; no new controls or Dual CT Energy activation.

1.10.57.en: Fix original STREAM updates being suppressed by unrelated realtime messages. Protect newer readings and energy counters. Recover widget refresh after stalled requests and page restoration. Clarify that configured capacity is used for widget estimates.

1.10.58.en: Improve Dual CT telemetry health diagnostics and prepare guarded Energy adoption and hardware acceptance. Energy activation and new battery controls remain disabled.

1.10.59.en: Prepare separate Dual CT property Energy pairing and persistent accounting safeguards, plus account repair without re-pairing. Dual CT Energy remains disabled pending source and hardware qualification.

1.11.0.en: Adds Homey Energy setup for single-phase CT1 on Smart Meter Dual CT firmware 1.0.0.41, with approximate power and estimated import/export totals. Improves reporting-gap and accounting handling, clears the persistent research warning, and preserves existing devices and history. Add the property Energy meter separately; CT2 and three-phase accounting are excluded. Test validation continues before production.

1.11.5.en: Fixes Smart Meter Dual CT Energy recovery when Homey’s rounded counters are restored after a restart or reporting interruption. Keeps accumulated totals and precise internal accounting, and shows a reconnecting message instead of an unsupported-meter error. Preserves the existing reserve-control bridge. Supported Energy scope remains single-phase CT1 on firmware 1.0.0.41; CT2 and three-phase Energy remain excluded. Existing paired Energy meters recover without re-pairing.

1.11.6.en: Adds an opt-in three-phase Dual CT CT1 community trial for Homey Energy on firmware 1.0.0.41. Uses signed phase netting, separate counter bindings, complete-packet and freshness guards, and local classification-only feedback in the integration support report. Single-phase pairing and existing counters are preserved. Three-phase field validation remains ongoing; CT2 is excluded.
1.11.6.de: Optionaler Dreiphasen-Community-Test für Dual CT CT1 in Homey Energy mit Firmware 1.0.0.41. Separate Zählerbindung, saldierte Phasen und lokales Feedback im Integrationsbericht. Bestehende einphasige Geräte und Zähler bleiben erhalten. Feldvalidierung läuft; CT2 ist ausgeschlossen.
1.11.6.nl: Optionele driefase-communitytest voor Dual CT CT1 in Homey Energy met firmware 1.0.0.41. Gesaldeerde fasen, aparte tellerbinding en lokale feedback in het integratierapport. Bestaande eenfase-apparaten en tellers blijven behouden. Praktijkvalidatie loopt; CT2 is uitgesloten.

1.11.7.en: Adds per-device CT1 single-/three-phase display and independent optional CT2 views. Adds voltage/current and per-phase details to the property Energy device without changing its accounting mode or counters. Detailed monitor diagnostics can be shown or hidden. Existing capability IDs, custom titles, history and Flow references are retained. Keeps healthy Dual CT Energy meters available during routine and overlapping updates, while retaining stale-data/failure warnings and precise counters.
1.11.7.de: CT1-Anzeige für eine oder drei Phasen und unabhängige optionale CT2-Ansichten. Zusätzliche Spannungs-/Strom- und Phasendetails am Energy-Gerät ohne Änderung der Berechnung oder Zähler. Monitordiagnose ein-/ausblendbar. Bestehende IDs, Titel, Verlauf und Flow-Verweise bleiben erhalten. Verhindert Verfügbarkeitsflackern bei normalen und überlappenden Dual-CT-Energy-Updates; veraltete Daten und Fehler werden weiterhin angezeigt, präzise Zähler bleiben erhalten.
1.11.7.nl: CT1-weergave voor een of drie fasen en onafhankelijke optionele CT2-weergaven. Extra spanning/stroom en fasedetails op het Energy-apparaat zonder wijziging van berekening of tellers. Monitordiagnose kan worden getoond of verborgen. Bestaande IDs, titels, geschiedenis en Flow-verwijzingen blijven behouden. Houdt gezonde Dual CT Energy-meters beschikbaar bij normale en overlappende updates; waarschuwingen voor verouderde gegevens en fouten en precieze tellers blijven behouden.

1.11.8.en: Makes Dual CT Energy meter verification visible with progress, a 30-second timeout and clear source, firmware, inventory or overlap failure messages. Corrects three-phase scope confirmation. Late responses cannot admit an expired review. Existing accounting, counters, single-phase devices and three-phase trial safeguards are unchanged.
1.11.8.de: Dual-CT-Energy-Zählerprüfung mit Fortschrittsanzeige, 30-Sekunden-Zeitlimit und klaren Meldungen zu Quelle, Firmware, Geräteprüfung oder überlappenden Zählern. Korrigiert die Dreiphasen-Bestätigung. Verspätete Antworten können keine abgelaufene Prüfung freigeben. Bestehende Berechnung, Zähler und Schutzprüfungen bleiben unverändert.
1.11.8.nl: Maakt de Dual CT Energy-metercontrole zichtbaar met voortgang, een time-out van 30 seconden en duidelijke meldingen over bron, firmware, apparatencontrole of overlappende meters. Corrigeert de driefasebevestiging. Late antwoorden kunnen een verlopen controle niet toelaten. Bestaande berekening, tellers en beveiligingen blijven ongewijzigd.

1.11.9.en: Improves shared Dual CT connections: confirming the same EcoFlow account keeps existing listeners running, multiple views share one meter subscription, and late callbacks from replaced connections cannot refresh readings or interrupt recovery. Identifies blocking Energy meters by name during pairing. Preserves existing devices, history, Flows and counters, single-phase accounting and three-phase community trial safeguards. Stale readings remain unavailable and reporting gaps are not backfilled.
1.11.9.de: Verbessert gemeinsam genutzte Dual-CT-Verbindungen: Die Bestätigung desselben EcoFlow-Kontos unterbricht bestehende Beobachter nicht, mehrere Ansichten teilen ein Zählerabonnement und verspätete Rückmeldungen alter Verbindungen aktualisieren keine Messwerte und stören die Wiederherstellung nicht. Nennt blockierende Energy-Zähler bei der Kopplung. Bestehende Geräte, Verlauf, Flows, Zählerstände sowie Einphasen-Berechnung und Schutzprüfungen des Dreiphasen-Community-Tests bleiben erhalten. Veraltete Werte bleiben nicht verfügbar; Meldelücken werden nicht nachträglich aufgefüllt.
1.11.9.nl: Verbetert gedeelde Dual CT-verbindingen: bevestiging van hetzelfde EcoFlow-account houdt bestaande ontvangers actief, meerdere weergaven delen één meterabonnement en late terugmeldingen van vervangen verbindingen kunnen metingen niet verversen of herstel verstoren. Toont bij het koppelen de namen van blokkerende Energy-meters. Behoudt bestaande apparaten, geschiedenis, Flows, tellers, eenfaseberekening en beveiligingen van de driefase-communitytest. Verouderde metingen blijven niet beschikbaar en rapportagegaten worden niet aangevuld.

1.11.10.en: Restores missing STREAM Home Battery (5000) battery percentages, including 0%, using the documented system SOC API when Developer credentials are configured. Preserves newer app readings, existing devices, power accounting and cumulative counters. Reports the source as the latest cloud report without claiming a device measurement timestamp. Physical-unit monitoring is unchanged.
1.11.10.de: Stellt fehlende Batteriestände der STREAM-Hausbatterie (5000), einschließlich 0 %, über die dokumentierte System-SOC-API wieder her, wenn Entwickler-Zugangsdaten eingerichtet sind. Neuere App-Messwerte, bestehende Geräte, Leistungsbilanz und kumulative Zähler bleiben erhalten. Kennzeichnet die Quelle als letzten Cloud-Bericht ohne behaupteten Geräte-Messzeitpunkt. Die Überwachung physischer Einheiten bleibt unverändert.
1.11.10.nl: Herstelt ontbrekende batterijpercentages van de STREAM-thuisbatterij (5000), inclusief 0%, via de gedocumenteerde systeem-SOC-API wanneer Developer-inloggegevens zijn ingesteld. Behoudt nieuwere appmetingen, bestaande apparaten, energieberekening en cumulatieve tellers. Vermeldt de bron als het laatste cloudrapport zonder een meettijdstip van het apparaat te claimen. Monitoring van fysieke units blijft ongewijzigd.

1.11.11.en: Improves Dual CT Energy recovery after reporting gaps without dropping its shared connection. Preserves counters and skips missing intervals for both single-phase and three-phase community meters. Adds local recovery classifications and protects original STREAM MQTT consumers from replaced connections and failing listeners. Three-phase Energy remains a community trial pending hardware validation.
1.11.11.de: Verbessert die Wiederherstellung von Dual CT Energy nach Meldelücken ohne Abbruch der gemeinsamen Verbindung. Zählerstände bleiben bei Einphasen- und Dreiphasen-Community-Zählern erhalten; fehlende Intervalle werden nicht ergänzt. Ergänzt lokale Diagnosekategorien und schützt ursprüngliche STREAM-MQTT-Empfänger vor alten Verbindungen und fehlerhaften Beobachtern. Dreiphasen-Energy bleibt bis zur Hardwarevalidierung ein Community-Test.
1.11.11.nl: Verbetert Dual CT Energy-herstel na rapportagegaten zonder de gedeelde verbinding te verbreken. Behoudt tellers en slaat ontbrekende intervallen over voor eenfase- en driefase-communitymeters. Voegt lokale herstelcategorieën toe en beschermt oorspronkelijke STREAM-MQTT-ontvangers tegen vervangen verbindingen en falende ontvangers. Driefase-Energy blijft een communitytest in afwachting van hardwarevalidatie.

1.11.12.en: Improves shared Dual CT telemetry startup and recovery: concurrent consumers wait for connection readiness, failed or unanswered subscriptions receive bounded retries, and late acknowledgements cannot affect replacement connections. Adds local delivery and frame-rejection diagnostics without raw household data or automatic uploads. Preserves devices, history, Flows, counters and single-/three-phase Energy accounting safeguards. Three-phase Energy remains a community trial.
1.11.12.de: Verbessert Start und Wiederherstellung gemeinsamer Dual-CT-Telemetrie: Gleichzeitige Empfänger warten auf die Verbindung; fehlgeschlagene oder unbeantwortete Abonnements werden begrenzt wiederholt. Verspätete Bestätigungen beeinflussen keine Ersatzverbindungen. Ergänzt lokale Diagnosekategorien ohne rohe Haushaltsdaten oder automatische Uploads. Geräte, Verlauf, Flows, Zähler und Energy-Schutzprüfungen bleiben erhalten. Dreiphasen-Energy bleibt ein Community-Test.
1.11.12.nl: Verbetert het opstarten en herstel van gedeelde Dual CT-telemetrie: gelijktijdige ontvangers wachten op de verbinding, mislukte of onbeantwoorde abonnementen krijgen begrensde herpogingen en late bevestigingen beïnvloeden geen vervangende verbindingen. Voegt lokale diagnosecategorieën toe zonder ruwe huishoudgegevens of automatische uploads. Behoudt apparaten, geschiedenis, Flows, tellers en Energy-beveiligingen. Driefase-Energy blijft een communitytest.

1.11.13.en: Restores original STREAM telemetry after temporary source-verification failures when the same main unit is verified again, and refreshes changed API credentials before verification. Prevents Dual CT Energy accounting across separate MQTT connections while preserving counters and stale-data safeguards. Adds regression coverage for sparse feeds and single-/three-phase recovery. Three-phase Energy remains a community trial; the cause of sparse meter delivery is still under investigation.
1.11.13.de: Stellt die ursprüngliche STREAM-Telemetrie nach vorübergehenden Fehlern der Quellenprüfung wieder her, sobald dieselbe Haupteinheit erneut bestätigt wurde. Aktualisiert geänderte API-Zugangsdaten vor der Prüfung. Verhindert Dual-CT-Energieberechnung über getrennte MQTT-Verbindungen hinweg; Zählerstände und Schutz vor veralteten Daten bleiben erhalten. Ergänzt Regressionstests für lückenhafte Meldungen und Ein-/Dreiphasen-Wiederherstellung. Dreiphasen-Energy bleibt ein Community-Test; die Ursache seltener Zählermeldungen wird weiter untersucht.
1.11.13.nl: Herstelt oorspronkelijke STREAM-telemetrie na tijdelijke fouten bij bronverificatie zodra dezelfde hoofdeenheid opnieuw is bevestigd, en vernieuwt gewijzigde API-inloggegevens vóór verificatie. Voorkomt Dual CT-energieberekening over verschillende MQTT-verbindingen met behoud van tellers en bescherming tegen verouderde gegevens. Voegt regressietests toe voor schaarse meldingen en een-/driefaseherstel. Driefase-Energy blijft een communitytest; de oorzaak van schaarse metermeldingen wordt nog onderzocht.

1.11.14.en: Improve shared EcoFlow account recovery, connection cleanup and STREAM 5000 retry handling. Preserve energy counters and stale-reading safeguards; improve connection messages and diagnostic privacy.
1.11.14.de: Verbessert die Wiederherstellung der EcoFlow-Verbindung und STREAM-5000-Wiederholungen. Energiezähler und Schutz vor veralteten Messwerten bleiben erhalten.
1.11.14.nl: Verbetert herstel van de EcoFlow-verbinding en STREAM 5000-verbindingspogingen. Energietellers en bescherming tegen verouderde metingen blijven behouden.
